name: rc4
label: rare_chars
note: rare_chars, two tiers in one pass (runs/explore/rc4_report.md, dev only, labels of 2026-10-22: core = foreign-script / U+FFFD / non-ASCII symbol garbage): rules without "tier" form the strict tier (per-corpus FPR target 0.1%); "tier": "monitor" rules are added on top for the monitoring tier (0.5%). Fixed rules + one learned-score rule per tier, the thresholds chosen on dev negatives by explore/rc4_frontier.py (SCORE='runs/explore/rc4_gb_dev_mech.npz' BASE='lpc<-4 & fs<0.002 & caseless_after_latin;bad_utf8;lp1<-2 & fs<0.01' MBASE='fs<0.01 & fsw<0.05 & caseless_after_latin' MARGIN='0.5' SHADOW_D='1.0'). gb: learned token score (explore/rc4_gb.py NAME=mech POS=na GATE=fs, detector/rare_gb.py) over per-token inputs only (logprobs, token / neighbour classes, character categories, shares; no reference counts, no token frequencies), evaluated where fs < 0.05 or bad_utf8 ("gate": "fs"); it looks one token ahead, so every alert of this config is raised one token after the triggering token. lp1 / lpc: log10 of the top-1 / generated token's probability; gap = lp1 - lpc.
